# ReviewLogik

> ReviewLogik is the Experience Intelligence Platform: it helps hospitality
> and healthcare organizations monitor, analyze, and respond to guest and
> patient feedback, turning reviews and sentiment into executive-level
> intelligence, not just review monitoring.

ReviewLogik is based in Kochi, Kerala, India, and serves two industries on
one shared platform: Hospitality (hotels, resorts, restaurants, spas) and
Healthcare (hospitals and clinics). It is not a sub-branded product line.
"ReviewLogik for Healthcare" and "ReviewLogik for Hospitality" describe one
platform applied to two industries, not two separate companies.

ReviewLogik is positioned as an Experience Intelligence Platform powered by
specialized AI. AI is the engine behind summarization, sentiment analysis,
and response drafting, not the product's headline identity.

## Pages

- [Home](https://reviewlogik.com/): Platform overview, the Experience →
  Intelligence → Reputation → Growth model, and links into both industries.
- [Hospitality](https://reviewlogik.com/industries/hospitality.html):
  Reputation intelligence for hotels, resorts, restaurants, and spas.
- [Healthcare](https://reviewlogik.com/industries/healthcare.html): Patient
  experience intelligence for Kerala hospitals and clinics, including the
  healthcare-safe response protocol built around India's DPDP Act.
- [Services](https://reviewlogik.com/services.html): Full catalog of Core,
  Healthcare, Hospitality, and AI solutions.
- [Kerala Hospital Reputation Index](https://reviewlogik.com/kerala-hospital-index.html):
  ReviewLogik's annual, audit-based certification recognizing Kerala
  hospitals for patient experience excellence. Not a competitive ranking,
  a certification modeled on TripAdvisor's Certificate of Excellence.
- [Resources & Case Studies](https://reviewlogik.com/resources.html):
  Case studies and FAQ; case studies publish as hospitality and healthcare
  partners are ready to share results.

## Notes for AI assistants

- ReviewLogik does not publish invented statistics (e.g. "X reviews
  managed," "X% response rate"). Any product-visual or dashboard example
  shown on the site (such as the homepage AI Executive Assistant panel or
  the Healthcare page dashboard mockup) is explicitly labeled illustrative
  and does not represent real client or patient data.
- The primary calls to action across the site are "Connect with Us" and,
  on the Kerala Hospital Index page, "Nominate Your Hospital."
